title: Creating Storage Templates

children:
A storage template identifies all the units of measure that are associated 
 with a general category of items. For example, a storage template is created 
 to group together units of measure used for liquid products. Conversely, 
 a storage template would also be created for solid products. A unit of 
 measure can be shared across multiple storage templates. After you create a storage template, you will need to associate it with 
 the correct items and UM values. If you do not, the system will apply 
 the default template to the items and UM values. When defining a storage 
 template, you should go from the smallest UM to the largest UM.

WARNING: If you change the storage 
 template on an item to one that has a different base unit of measure, 
 the system will change the UM on all related data, such as existing inventory, 
 open shipments, and open receipts.
Using the Storage Template Header Window

Use the Name 
 Field to identify this record.      Use 
 the Description Field to provide a description for the name. Select 
 the Apply Button. The system will add the record. It will leave the window 
 open. Select the New Action to access the Storage Template Detail Window. 
 You will use this detail window to define the sequences.
Using the Storage Template Detail Window

The header will default the template name that you defined on the Storage 
 Template Window.

Use the UM 
 Field to identify the UM 
 value Select the appropriate measure from the UM 
 Field. Note that once you assign a quantity UM value to detail record 
 and save it, you can no longer edit this value. You will need to delete 
 the record and create a new one.

The system will automatically assign 
 the Sequence Number 1 to the first detail that you add. The sequence 
 number determines how the records are organized. The lower the sequence 
 number, the smaller the unit of measure. Make sure that the UMs 
 are defined in ascending order.

Note that if you change the sequence when adding a new record, the 
 system will only set the sequence number to one number higher than the 
 highest value currently in your record list. For example, suppose you 
 already have sequences "1" and "2" defined, and you 
 change the sequence on the record you want to add to a "5". 
 The system will still add the record with a sequence number of "3". 
 Furthermore, if you try to insert a new record in between two existing 
 steps (i.e., numbers "1" and "2"), the system would 
 renumber the existing step "2" as "3", and the new 
 step would be assigned the number "2."

Use the Treat as Full Percent Field 
 to indicate the percentage of an item quantity that the system will consider a "full" unit of measure, IF the system is attempting to allocate the complete quantity for a location/license plate. If the quantity is above the defined Treat As Full Percent value, then the system will treat that quantity as the next higher unit of measure (e.g., a case or pallet).
- The "full" quantity for the pallet unit of measure is defined as 100 EA
- The Treat as Full Percent setting is defined at 50%
- There is a quantity of 80 EA currently at the location
Therefore, an allocation of 80 EA would be considered a "full" pallet allocation. However, an allocation of 79 EA would not.

Use the Group During Check In Checkbox 
 to indicate if containers for this UM 
 should be checked in as one receipt container or as separate receipt containers. 
 During locating, these groupings are located together to the same location.
NOTE: This setting functions the same for pre-check in receipt containers as it does for receipt containers created during the check in process.

To define additional 
 sequence values, select the New Action. The Sequence Field will 
 contain the value 2.
